description: List the secrets a hosted Claude loop (or an organisation) holds — names and dates, never values. Pass loop (the hosted Claude loop's id, from /connect/claude/deploy) for the loop's own secret — its owner only — or org (organisation slug, admin-scoped token) for an organisation-level secret every loop of the organisation inherits; a loop-level name overrides the organisation's. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is the loop's model key (CAP-S.8: the platform never lends its own); at organisation level it is the BYOK override. Returns {scope, secrets:[{name, scope, createdAt, updatedAt, lastUsedAt}], inherited:[…]} where inherited are the organisation-level names a loop gets unless it overrides them.
name: merjax_list_loop_secrets
